data.name: Pearl Harbor Remembered A - from Waikiki
data.headline: Tour 66A • Pick Up Starting at 6:30am
data.description: The Pearl Harbor Remembered tour immerses visitors in history, from the events leading to the Pearl Harbor attack to its aftermath. Experience multimedia exhibits, a boat ride to the USS Arizona Memorial, a tour of the Battleship Missouri, and downtown Honolulu’s rich cultural history.
data.highlights:
- Explore Pearl Harbor Visitor Center exhibits
- Visit the USS Arizona Memorial
- Tour the historic Battleship Missouri
- Drive through downtown Honolulu’s landmarks
data.itinerary:
- **Pick-up:** From Waikiki 
- **Pearl Harbor Visitor Center:** Exhibits and multimedia displays
- **USS Arizona Memorial:** Boat ride and guided experience
- **Battleship Missouri:** Tour of the iconic battleship
- **Downtown Honolulu:** Drive-by of historic landmarks
- **Return:** To Waikiki or Ko’Olina
data.what_is_included:
- Admission to Pearl Harbor Visitor Center
- USS Arizona Memorial entry
- Battleship Missouri tour
- Downtown Honolulu drive-by
data.what_is_not_included: - Storage for bags at Pearl Harbor ($8.00 per bag)
data.what_to_bring:
- Government-issued ID
- Comfortable clothing and shoes
- No large bags (storage available for $8.00 per bag)
data.cancellation_summary: Cancellations are allowed with a 24-hour advance notice.
data.cancellation_notes:
• Cancellations: In order to be eligible for a refund, cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to the start of your tour. Unfortunately, no refunds will be issued for tours cancelled within 24 hours of the tour start time.

• Private Charter Cancellations: In order to be eligible for a refund, cancellations must be made at least 72 hours prior to the start of your charter. Unfortunately, no refunds will be issued for charters cancelled within 24 hours of your scheduled start time.

• Please call (808) 591-2561 to reconfirm your tour at least 24 hours prior.

• Please report any disability requiring special attention at time of booking.  E Noa will make all reasonable attempts to accommodate visitor’s needs.

• All reservations subject to availability with departure times, dates, schedules and fares subject to change without notice.

• E Noa Corporation shall not be liable for any injury, loss, damage, or accident to persons or property of any individual on tour from any cause beyond its control.
data.booking_notes:
##Stops and sites on the Pearl Harbor Remembered Tour include:##

o   WWII Valor in the Pacific National Monument & USS *Arizona* Memorial
o   USS Missouri Battleship on Ford Island
o   Historic Downtown Honolulu (drive through only)

• Driver reserves right to adjust route for maximum visitor enjoyment and safety
• Be ready for spur-of-the-moment stops, unexpected views and special sightseeing along the way!

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**  

• Bring government issued ID; security restrictions at Pearl Harbor will be enforced. CLEAR BAGS ONLY (no non see-through bags that could offer concealment.) Storage is available at Pearl Harbor for $8.00 per item.

• Our tours do not allow guests to meet directly at Pearl Harbor. Guests must meet at one of the pick up locations offered; you may not drive out to Pearl Harbor on your own. 

• Attire: Dress comfortably, but please remember that shirts and footwear are required on the USS Arizona Memorial; swimsuits not permitted. High heels, dresses and skirts are not recommended. 

• Snacks and drinks are available and may be purchased independently at the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center and the USS Missouri gift shop.

**NOTE:** Due to unforeseen circumstances beyond our control, the Navy may suspend boat operations to the USS Arizona Memorial at any time or impose a capacity restriction on the boat; as a result, occasionally, you may be placed in the standby line. Please accept our apologies in advance.
